199: static block constant_fold(block a, block b, int op) {
200:   if (!block_is_single(a) || !block_is_const(a) ||
201:       !block_is_single(b) || !block_is_const(b))
202:     return gen_noop();
203:   if (op == '+') {
204:     if (block_const_kind(a) == JV_KIND_NULL) {
205:       block_free(a);
206:       return b;
207:     }
208:     if (block_const_kind(b) == JV_KIND_NULL) {
209:       block_free(b);
210:       return a;
211:     }
212:   }
213:   if (block_const_kind(a) != block_const_kind(b))
214:     return gen_noop();
215: 
216:   jv res = jv_invalid();
217: 
218:   if (block_const_kind(a) == JV_KIND_NUMBER) {
219:     jv jv_a = block_const(a);
220:     jv jv_b = block_const(b);
221: 
222:     double na = jv_number_value(jv_a);
223:     double nb = jv_number_value(jv_b);
224: 
225:     int cmp = jv_cmp(jv_a, jv_b);
226: 
227:     switch (op) {
228:     case '+': res = jv_number(na + nb); break;
229:     case '-': res = jv_number(na - nb); break;
230:     case '*': res = jv_number(na * nb); break;
231:     case '/': res = jv_number(na / nb); break;
232:     case EQ:  res = (cmp == 0 ? jv_true() : jv_false()); break;
233:     case NEQ: res = (cmp != 0 ? jv_true() : jv_false()); break;
234:     case '<': res = (cmp < 0 ? jv_true() : jv_false()); break;
235:     case '>': res = (cmp > 0 ? jv_true() : jv_false()); break;
236:     case LESSEQ: res = (cmp <= 0 ? jv_true() : jv_false()); break;
237:     case GREATEREQ: res = (cmp >= 0 ? jv_true() : jv_false()); break;
238:     default: break;
239:     }
240:   } else if (op == '+' && block_const_kind(a) == JV_KIND_STRING) {
241:     res = jv_string_concat(block_const(a),  block_const(b));
242:   } else {
243:     return gen_noop();
244:   }
245: 
246:   if (jv_get_kind(res) == JV_KIND_INVALID)
247:     return gen_noop();
248: 
249:   block_free(a);
250:   block_free(b);
251:   return gen_const(res);
252: }
